{{Otheruses|Banks}}
A [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] '''primary performance bank''' was it's active memory, in essence its consciousness. This is where a droid would perform much of its processing, and when a droid received a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]], these banks are what would be erased.
